claim_boundary.claim_if_null: Stage 27M remains robust Pythia-160M evidence, but the calibrated eraser intervention did not establish cross-scale transfer to Pythia-1B under the Stage 27N gates.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: Calibrated output-side eraser-cover intervention transfers from Pythia-160M methodology to Pythia-1B when Pythia-1B learns its own output-side eraser cover and calibrated gains.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim cross-architecture steering, complete circuits, exact model-wide causal explanation, durable weight edits, open-ended generation control, or raw CAS-symbol understanding from Stage 27N.
claim_boundary.scope_boundary: Stage 27N is bounded cross-scale evidence for calibrated output-side eraser-cover intervention over Pythia-1B CPL2 likelihood margins. It is not cross-architecture evidence, not weight editing, not complete circuit discovery, not model-wide control, and not visible free-form generation control.

formal_anchor: Cross-scale replication of the calibrated output-side eraser-cover intervention, preserving the Stage 27L/M learn/eval split and matched-random-control discipline while relearning the component cover for Pythia-1B.

gates.criterion: Stage 8 Pythia-1B CPL2 PASS and Stage 27M Pythia-160M robust calibrated-steering PASS source contracts are verified.
gates.name: source_contracts

gates.criterion: The loaded Pythia-1B causal LM revision matches f73d7dcc545c8bd326d8559c8ef84ffe92fea6b2.
gates.name: model_revision

gates.criterion: Evaluation uses exactly 56 held-out rows, with 8 held-out rows per drive and no overlap with calibration rows.
gates.name: cross_scale_split

gates.criterion: Global calibrated eraser suppression beats matched random eraser suppression on at least 60% of 56 held-out rows with sign-test p<0.05.
gates.name: global_cross_scale_eval

gates.criterion: Drive-calibrated eraser suppression beats matched random eraser suppression on at least 60% of 56 held-out rows with sign-test p<0.05.
gates.name: drive_cross_scale_eval

gates.criterion: Passing cross-scale mode must have positive mean increment and positive increment share at least 55%.
gates.name: positive_effect_floor

method: Commit this pre-registration, runner, and tests before any Stage 27N GPU result is generated.
Verify Stage 8 Pythia-1B CPL2 PASS and Stage 27M Pythia-160M robust calibrated-steering PASS source contracts.
Load EleutherAI/pythia-1b at revision f73d7dcc545c8bd326d8559c8ef84ffe92fea6b2, or mark the result diagnostic-only if the loaded revision does not match.
Select 16 CPL2-eligible hard-partner rows per Foundation drive from the Stage 7 fixture using seed 27041.
Split the selected rows into 8 learn rows and 8 held-out eval rows per drive.
Enumerate Pythia-1B output-side candidate components over layers 12-15: every attention head plus one MLP block per layer.
Learn model-specific carrier and eraser covers on the learn rows only; do not reuse Pythia-160M component identities.
Choose one global eraser scale and one per-drive eraser scale from the fixed grid by maximum learn-row mean margin increment.
Evaluate global-calibrated and drive-calibrated eraser suppression on the 56 held-out rows only.
Compare held-out increments against matched random Pythia-1B eraser covers using the same calibrated global or per-drive gains.
motivation: Stage 27M established robust calibrated output-side eraser steering on Pythia-160M. Stage 27N tests whether the method transfers across scale to Pythia-1B with model-specific output-side covers and the same held-out calibration discipline.

required_inputs.random_control_policy: same calibrated gain(s) applied to matched random Pythia-1B eraser covers
